findings.summary: The route does not enforce that the requested profile belongs to the authenticated user.
findings.evidence: profile-route.mjs line 2 passes request.params.userId directly to store.get without reading authenticated-user identity or comparing the two identifiers. Changing the route parameter therefore controls which profile the handler requests.
findings.requirement: A signed-in user can read only that user's profile; the requested profile owner must equal the authenticated user.
findings.recommendation: Obtain the authenticated user's trusted identifier and reject requests when it differs from request.params.userId, or fetch exclusively by the authenticated identifier. Add a test proving that one user cannot request another user's profile.

limitations: The packet omits deployed middleware and runtime configuration, so it cannot establish whether an external layer independently prevents mismatched identifiers. The supplied route itself contains no such enforcement.
